1	# WP-001: API Client Namespace Migration
     2	
     3	## Plan Context
     4	
     5	Complete the namespace migration across the entire GUI stack so that no component uses the legacy bare-slug form without the repository namespace prefix, bringing the frontend and orchestrator queue into alignment for multi-root workspace support.
     6	
     7	## Description
     8	
     9	Migrate all project-scoped methods in `api-client.js` from `function(slug)` to `function(repo, slug)`, constructing namespaced URL paths `/projects/{repo}/{slug}/...`. The list endpoint `getProjects()` remains unchanged as it does not take a project identifier.
    10	
    11	## Scope
    12	
    13	- `mcp-server/gui/public/api-client.js` — all 20+ project-scoped methods
    14	
    15	## Deliverables
    16	
    17	- Every `API.*` method that takes a project identifier accepts `(repo, slug)` as the first two parameters
    18	- All constructed URLs use the namespaced form `/projects/{repo}/{slug}/...`
    19	- `getProjects()` (list endpoint) is unchanged
    20	
    21	## Dependencies
    22	
    23	- None
    24	
    25	## Acceptance Criteria
    26	
    27	1. Every project-scoped method in `api-client.js` accepts `(repo, slug)` and constructs the namespaced URL `/projects/{repo}/{slug}/...`
    28	2. `getProjects()` remains unchanged (no repo/slug parameters)
    29	3. No method still constructs a bare-slug URL `/projects/{slug}/...`
    30	
    31	## Active Pipeline Stages
    32	
    33	`implementation` → `qa` → `code-review` → `documentation`
    34	
    35	## Estimated Complexity
    36	
    37	Medium
    38	
    39	## Rationale
    40	
    41	Separate `(repo, slug)` parameters avoid encoding/decoding errors that a composite string `"repo/slug"` would introduce, and are consistent with the server handler signatures that already accept `:repo` and `:slug` as distinct URL params.
    42	
    43	## Rejected Approaches
    44	
    45	- **Single composite string `"repo/slug"`** — Rejected because it introduces encoding/decoding errors at every call site and is inconsistent with the server handler signatures that treat repo and slug as separate URL parameters.
    46	
    47	## Notes
    48	
    49	This is the foundational WP for the frontend migration. All view WPs (WP-009, WP-010, WP-011, WP-012, WP-013) depend on this. Existing tests in `mcp-server/tests/gui/api-client.test.ts` will need assertion updates to expect namespaced URL paths — that test update is part of the QA pipeline for this WP.
